corrections.reason: The Ge'ez word for 'my foot' (Isaiah 66:1: መከየደ እግርየ) has the 6th-order 'ግ' (ሳድስ) with the top-left serif clearly visible in the image, not 1st-order 'ገ'.
In 2 Peter 3:3 ('know this first', translated in L26 as አስቀድማችሁ ዕወቁ), the Ge'ez plural imperative is 'አእምሩ' (with 2nd-order 'ሩ'), which is visible on the right side of the stem in the image.

The Ge'ez Psalm reference for 'He hath founded it upon the seas' is Psalm 23:2 (መዝ ፳፫ ፥ ፪ in Septuagint/Ge'ez numbering, corresponding to Masoretic Ps 24:2). Visually, the second numeral is '፫' (3), not '፬' (4).
